import type * as Napi from 'caliper-docgen-napi'

export interface SessionOptions {
  /** Absolute source directories. */
  srcDirs: string[]
  exclude?: string[]
  tsconfigPath?: string
  skipHtmlProps?: boolean
  htmlAttributes?: Napi.JsExtractOptions['htmlAttributes']
  /** Read and write the on-disk caches. Default: `true`. */
  cache?: boolean
  loadDependencies?: boolean
  collapseInheritedProps?: Napi.JsExtractOptions['collapseInheritedProps']
  /**
   * Resolve a component when a story asks for it rather than every component at start. Default: `true`. The answers
   * are the same; a session that serves a few components of many starts and holds less.
   */
  lazy?: boolean
  /**
   * Ask the built-in TypeScript checker for each component a story names. Default: `true`: it is kept warm, asked for
   * exactly the requested component, and the structural props stand when it is slower than `semanticWaitMs`. `false`
   * never starts it.
   */
  checker?: boolean
  /** How many milliseconds a story waits for the checker before it takes the structural props. Default: `150`. */
  semanticWaitMs?: number
  /**
   * How many milliseconds a story waits for the checker when caliper-docgen's own pass lists no props for its component.
   * Default: `2000`.
   */
  semanticWaitEmptyMs?: number
}

/** What the native session is created with: the session's options, with `lazy` decided by the caller. */
export function toNapiOptions(options: SessionOptions, lazy: boolean): Napi.JsExtractOptions {
  return {
    srcDirs: options.srcDirs,
    exclude: options.exclude,
    tsconfigPath: options.tsconfigPath,
    htmlAttributes: options.htmlAttributes ?? (options.skipHtmlProps ? 'none' : undefined),
    cache: options.cache,
    loadDependencies: options.loadDependencies,
    collapseInheritedProps: options.collapseInheritedProps,
    lazy,
    checker: options.checker,
    semanticWaitMs: options.semanticWaitMs,
    semanticWaitEmptyMs: options.semanticWaitEmptyMs,
  }
}

1	//! Options for one extraction run.
2	//!
3	//! These live in `types/` so the resolver and the dependency loader can read them without importing `pipeline`;
4	//! `pipeline` re-exports them, so `caliper_docgen_core::pipeline::PipelineOptions` and the others keep their paths.
5	
6	use camino::{Utf8Path, Utf8PathBuf};
7	use rustc_hash::FxHashSet;
8	use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
9	
10	/// How much of an inherited HTML element's attribute surface to expose.
11	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
12	#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
13	pub enum HtmlAttributeMode {
14	    /// A compact subset per element: `ref`, `aria-*`, every event handler but the `*Capture` twins, the global
15	    /// attributes and the element's own notable ones, kept in `notableInherited`. Opt-in; `Full` is the default.
16	    Curated,
17	    /// Actually resolve `@types/react`'s real `HTMLAttributes`/`AriaAttributes`/
18	    /// `DOMAttributes`/`<Element>HTMLAttributes` interface chain, matching RDT's
19	    /// full ~250-300 attributes per element — the default.
20	    Full,
21	    /// Don't synthesize any inherited HTML attributes at all — own props only.
22	    None,
23	}
24	
25	impl HtmlAttributeMode {
26	    /// The mode named by a config or binding string. `Err` carries the unrecognized value, so callers can name it
27	    /// instead of silently falling back to a default.
28	    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<Self, &str> {
29	        match s {
30	            "curated" => Ok(Self::Curated),
31	            "full" => Ok(Self::Full),
32	            "none" => Ok(Self::None),
33	            other => Err(other),
34	        }
35	    }
36	}
37	
38	/// Which inherited sources are recorded as an `InheritedLayer` of names instead of expanded prop by prop (collapse).
39	/// A component's own props type is always expanded. A dependency source collapses when it is ambient (DOM and ARIA
40	/// attributes, style systems) and declares more than 30 props; a dependency's own API is listed unless it declares more
41	/// than 200 props. By default a project source declaring more than 200 props collapses too.
42	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
43	#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
44	pub enum CollapseInheritedProps {
45	    /// Large ambient sources declared in a loaded dependency (`load_dependencies`), a dependency's sources of more than
46	    /// 200 props, and the project's own sources of more than 200 props. The default.
47	    #[default]
48	    Dependencies,
49	    /// Those, and the project's own sources of more than 30 props.
50	    All,
51	    /// Expand every source.
52	    None,
53	}
54	
55	impl CollapseInheritedProps {
56	    /// The mode named by a config or binding string. `Err` carries the unrecognized value.
57	    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<Self, &str> {
58	        match s {
59	            "dependencies" => Ok(Self::Dependencies),
60	            "all" => Ok(Self::All),
61	            "none" => Ok(Self::None),
62	            other => Err(other),
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    /// Whether an inherited source of type `type_name` in `file`, of which `reaching` props reach the component, is
67	    /// recorded as a layer of names instead of listed prop by prop. `dependency` says the file is a loaded dependency's.
68	    /// A component's own props type is never asked.
69	    ///
70	    /// The one owner of the decision, and both lanes give it the same input, `reaching`; no declared member count is
71	    /// read anywhere. `reaching` is the number of distinct
72	    /// members of the source that reach the component after `Omit` and `Pick` (a member reached through two paths counts
73	    /// once). For a plain `extends` it is what the source declares. A `Pick` names its keys on purpose, so the props it
74	    /// picks are listed however large the source: neither lane asks about them. The structural resolver expands what a
75	    /// `Pick` applies to, and counts the members a source declares less the keys the `Omit`s around it take
76	    /// (`ResolveState::omitted`, so only that source is affected); the checker's merge counts the props of its answer
77	    /// whose `parent` is the source, which are exactly the members that reach, and asks only for a source the checker
78	    /// proved the props type reaches whole: one under a `Pick`, a mapped type or a project alias of either is listed
79	    /// without asking (`SemanticComponent::whole`, `crate::types::semantic::layer_checker_props`).
80	    ///
81	    /// - A dependency source collapses when it is ambient (`crate::types::ambient`: DOM and ARIA attributes, style
82	    ///   systems) and past [`COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD`] props, or when it is not ambient but past [`LARGE_API_SOURCE`] props.
83	    ///   Otherwise it is listed: what a dependency's component exposes is the API a reader needs typed, and a small
84	    ///   ambient source costs more as a layer than as props.
85	    /// - A project source collapses past [`LARGE_API_SOURCE`] props in the default mode, as a dependency source that is
86	    ///   not ambient does: a style system is as large in the project's own source (Chakra's `SystemProperties`
87	    ///   declares 705) as installed. Its name is not read. Under [`Self::All`] it collapses past
88	    ///   [`COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD`].
89	    /// - A file in `node_modules` that is not a dependency's (`@types/react`, TypeScript's libraries) never collapses:
90	    ///   React's attributes follow `htmlAttributes`.
91	    /// - Under [`Self::None`] nothing collapses.
92	    pub(crate) fn collapses(self, dependency: bool, file: &str, type_name: &str, reaching: usize) -> bool {
93	        let project_threshold = match self {
94	            Self::None => return false,
95	            Self::Dependencies => LARGE_API_SOURCE,
96	            Self::All => COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD,
97	        };
98	        if dependency {
99	            let ambient = crate::types::ambient::is_ambient_source(file, type_name);
100	            reaching > if ambient { COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD } else { LARGE_API_SOURCE }
101	        } else {
102	            reaching > project_threshold && !in_node_modules(file)
103	        }
104	    }
105	}
106	
107	/// What a merge of the checker's answer needs to decide a collapse of a source only the checker read: the run's mode
108	/// and whether it loads dependencies, so a source in `node_modules` is a dependency's exactly when the structural pass
109	/// would have loaded it (`CollapseInheritedProps::collapses`'s `dependency`).
110	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
111	pub struct CollapseContext {
112	    /// The run's `collapseInheritedProps`.
113	    pub mode: CollapseInheritedProps,
114	    /// The run's `loadDependencies`.
115	    pub load_dependencies: bool,
116	}
117	
118	impl CollapseContext {
119	    /// Collapses nothing the structural answer did not: what a merge whose caller gives no options uses.
120	    pub const OFF: Self = Self { mode: CollapseInheritedProps::None, load_dependencies: false };
121	
122	    /// The run's choices.
123	    pub fn of(options: &PipelineOptions) -> Self {
124	        Self { mode: options.collapse_inherited_props, load_dependencies: options.load_dependencies }
125	    }
126	
127	    /// Whether a source only the checker read collapses: `reaching` of its members reach the component
128	    /// ([`CollapseInheritedProps::collapses`]), and its file is a dependency's when it is in `node_modules` and the run
129	    /// loads dependencies.
130	    pub(crate) fn collapses(self, file: &str, type_name: &str, reaching: usize) -> bool {
131	        let dependency = self.load_dependencies && in_node_modules(file);
132	        (dependency || !in_node_modules(file)) && self.mode.collapses(dependency, file, type_name, reaching)
133	    }
134	}
135	
136	/// A source declaring more than this many props can collapse: an ambient dependency source (`crate::types::ambient`),
137	/// or a project source under [`CollapseInheritedProps::All`]. Storybook's react-component-meta hides a dependency
138	/// source contributing more than this many props, whatever it contains; here an API source is hidden only past
139	/// [`LARGE_API_SOURCE`].
140	pub(crate) const COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD: usize = 30;
141	
142	/// Any other source collapses past this many props by default: a dependency source that is not ambient by name, or a
143	/// project source. It is a style system, not an API. Chakra v3's `SystemProperties` declares 705 and, listed, took a
144	/// four-component app from 516 KB to 1.96 MB; the largest source that is an API in the pinned corpora and in apps on
145	/// Chakra, Mantine and MUI declares 75 (`docs/measurement.md`, "Collapse by relevance").
146	pub(crate) const LARGE_API_SOURCE: usize = 200;
147	
148	/// Whether `path` is inside a `node_modules` directory.
149	pub(crate) fn in_node_modules(path: &str) -> bool {
150	    path.contains("/node_modules/") || path.contains(r"\node_modules\")

153	/// Configuration for a single extraction run.
154	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
155	pub struct PipelineOptions {
156	    /// Source directories to scan.
157	    pub src_dirs: Vec<Utf8PathBuf>,
158	    /// Extra gitignore-style glob patterns to exclude, relative to each source directory (on top of built-in: stories,
159	    /// tests, snapshots).
160	    pub exclude_patterns: Vec<String>,
161	    /// Component name prefixes to skip.
162	    pub exclude_prefixes: Vec<String>,
163	    /// How much of an inherited HTML element's attributes to expose.
164	    pub html_attributes: HtmlAttributeMode,
165	    /// Path to the tsconfig that governs module resolution. When unset, each importing file uses the nearest
166	    /// `tsconfig.json` above it, and the one above the first source directory supplies `customConditions`.
167	    pub tsconfig_path: Option<Utf8PathBuf>,
168	    /// Additional builtin type names beyond the React standard set.
169	    pub extra_builtins: FxHashSet<compact_str::CompactString>,
170	    /// Cache directory. Defaults to `node_modules/.cache/caliper-docgen` under the nearest ancestor of the first source
171	    /// directory that has a `node_modules` or a `package.json` (a directory in the OS temp directory when there is
172	    /// none), so the CLI, the Vite plugin and the Storybook addon share one cache whatever directory they run from.
173	    pub cache_dir: Option<Utf8PathBuf>,
174	    /// Read and write the on-disk caches (the declaration parse cache and the dependency index) under `cache_dir`.
175	    /// Off, a run reads and writes nothing there and parses everything; its output is the same. On by default.
176	    pub use_cache: bool,
177	    /// Load the dependency declarations project types reference, by name, before resolving (ADR 0010). On by default
178	    /// (`docs/performance.md`); off, a type imported from a package resolves only when it is a builtin or a known
179	    /// shortcut. A project with no installed packages loads nothing either way.
180	    pub load_dependencies: bool,
181	    /// Which large inherited sources to record as a layer instead of expanding.
182	    pub collapse_inherited_props: CollapseInheritedProps,
183	    /// Ask the built-in TypeScript checker for each component's props and merge them over the structural result
184	    /// (ADR 0026, `docs/type-checker-integration.md`). On by default; off, the structural resolver answers alone.
185	    /// `extract` ignores it: the checker backend lives in `caliper-docgen-semantic`, which depends on this crate, so
186	    /// the embedding (the CLI) runs it and calls [`crate::types::semantic::merge_semantic`].
187	    pub checker: bool,
188	}
189	
190	impl Default for PipelineOptions {
191	    fn default() -> Self {
192	        Self {
193	            src_dirs: vec![Utf8PathBuf::from("./src")],
194	            exclude_patterns: vec![],
195	            exclude_prefixes: vec![],
196	            html_attributes: HtmlAttributeMode::Full,
197	            tsconfig_path: None,
198	            extra_builtins: Default::default(),
199	            cache_dir: None,
200	            use_cache: true,
201	            load_dependencies: true,
202	            collapse_inherited_props: CollapseInheritedProps::default(),
203	            checker: true,
204	        }
205	    }
206	}

208	impl PipelineOptions {
209	    /// Where the parse and dependency caches (and `extract`'s kept checker answer) live: `cache_dir` when set, else
210	    /// `node_modules/.cache/caliper-docgen` under the nearest ancestor of the first source directory that has a
211	    /// `node_modules` or a `package.json`, so running from another directory neither misses the project's cache nor
212	    /// creates a `node_modules` there. A source directory in no project gets a directory in the OS temp directory.
213	    pub fn effective_cache_dir(&self) -> Utf8PathBuf {
214	        if let Some(dir) = &self.cache_dir {
215	            return dir.clone();
216	        }
217	        const CACHE: &str = "node_modules/.cache/caliper-docgen";
218	        let root = canonicalize_first_src_dir(&self.src_dirs).and_then(|src| {
219	            src.ancestors()
220	                .find(|dir| dir.join("node_modules").is_dir() || dir.join("package.json").is_file())
221	                .map(Utf8Path::to_owned)
222	        });
223	        match root {
224	            Some(root) => root.join(CACHE),
225	            None => {
226	                let temp = std::env::temp_dir();
227	                Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf(temp).unwrap_or_else(|_| Utf8PathBuf::from(".")).join("caliper-docgen-cache")
228	            }
229	        }
230	    }

233	/// Canonicalize `src_dirs`' first entry to use as the "from" directory for
234	/// resolving @types/react and TypeScript's own lib.d.ts files — must match
235	/// what discovered file paths look like (always absolute — the `ignore`
236	/// walker absolutizes them regardless of whether --src was given as relative
237	/// or absolute), since the resolver looks this same specifier up again
238	/// per-component relative to each file's own absolute directory. A relative
239	/// src_dirs entry has too few path components for oxc_resolver's ancestor
240	/// walk to ever reach the real node_modules tree, so it silently finds
241	/// nothing instead of the intended real package.
242	pub(crate) fn canonicalize_first_src_dir(src_dirs: &[Utf8PathBuf]) -> Option<Utf8PathBuf> {
243	    src_dirs.first().and_then(|dir| crate::canonical_path::canonicalize(dir).ok())

13:- **Prop sets.** A component's `props` is an array of prop set ids. A prop set is the props one declaring type (`parent`) contributes, as prop name to prop id; props with no declaring type form a set of their own, first. A prop name is in exactly one of a component's sets. Components that inherit a type share its set. The `propSets` table holds each set once.
14:- **Name lists.** An inheritance layer's `omitted` and a diagnostic's `affects` are ids into a `nameLists` table. A diagnostic with no `affects` has no field, as before.
15-- **Ids** are 64-bit FNV-1a hashes written as 16 hex digits, like prop ids: of a set's (name, prop id) entries in name order, and of a list's names in order. The same content has the same id in every output and update, so a client merges tables. Two different sets or lists with one id fail serialization.
16:- **Update and index.** `IncrementalUpdate` carries `propSets` and `nameLists` with every entry its components and diagnostics refer to. The session index (`initializeSessionIndex`) carries `nameLists` for its diagnostics.
17-- **Reading.** The Rust types stay inline as in ADR 0009 and only write the tables; the TypeScript readers expand the ids. (`ExtractionOutput` once had a `Deserialize` that expanded them; nothing read it, and it was removed.)
18-- `notableInherited` stays a name-to-prop-id map: it is 159 KB on Chakra. `--format rdt`, `--format storybook` and `--format toon` are unchanged.

# Diagnosis: 437 Controls rows (A) and the @types/react recall drop (B)

Binary: the existing `oracle-run/target/release/caliper-docgen` (built from de016f69, not rebuilt). Source read at de016f69. Fixture: `sb-demo/src` itself (`Badge` = `ComponentProps<'span'> & {variant, asChild}`, `Button` = Chakra `ButtonProps & ComponentProps<'button'> & {...}`), `@types/react` and `@chakra-ui/react` installed in `sb-demo/node_modules`. Run: `extract --src sb-demo/src --json --no-cache` x checker on/off x `--html-attributes full|curated|none` x `--collapse-inherited-props dependencies|none` (12 runs, all exit 0).

Demo config checked first: `sb-demo/.storybook/main.ts` sets only `srcDirs`, `semanticWaitMs`, `prefetchStories`. No `collapseInheritedProps` and no `htmlAttributes`, so the defaults apply: `dependencies` and `full` (`packages/storybook/src/options.ts:40,43` pass `undefined` through; `crates/core/src/types/options.rs:47,196`).

## Measured (Button / Badge)

Rows = props + notableInherited, which is what `docgen_info` hands Storybook (`crates/core/src/pipeline/rdt.rs:63-72`). Layers are never expanded into rows.

- off (structural), full, dependencies: Button 439 props (289 from @types/react), Badge 281 (279 from @types/react). SystemProperties is a layer (706 names).
- on (checker), full, dependencies: Button 150 props (0 from @types/react, 130 Chakra `Conditions`), Badge 2. The element layers `React.ComponentProps[button]` and `[span]` have `totalProps 0` and no members.
- on or off, curated, dependencies: Button 150 + 164 notable = 314 rows, Badge 2 + 159 notable = 161.
- none: Button 150, Badge 2. Collapse `none` changes only SystemProperties (Button 853 props); it never changes the DOM props.

Storybook shows Button 437 and Badge 280. That is the structural full count (439 and 281) less `key`/`ref`/`children` that `arg-types.ts:12-20` and the RDT `children` rule drop. The CLI checker lane shows 150 and 2 for the same input. **The two checker lanes disagree on the same options.**

## A. 437 rows in Storybook

**Cause.** The session (Storybook) merge keeps every `@types/react` prop under `htmlAttributes: 'full'`. In `crates/core/src/react_types.rs:439-441`, `checker_prop_used` gives `HtmlAttributeMode::Full => true`, and it is applied in `crates/core/src/pipeline/semantic_hook.rs:338-341`. `react_props_wanted` (`react_types.rs:452-453`) asks the checker for all of them. Collapse never touches `@types/react`:

- `options.rs:89-90`: "A file in `node_modules` that is not a dependency's (`@types/react`, TypeScript's libraries) never collapses: React's attributes follow `htmlAttributes`."
- In the checker lane, `checker_sources` skips `react_declared` props (`crates/core/src/types/semantic.rs:715-716`).

The roughly 130 Chakra condition props (`_active`, `2xl`...) are listed because `Conditions` is not ambient by name (`crates/core/src/types/ambient.rs:101-105`: only `SystemProps`, `*StyleProps` and style prefixes). Its 130 props are under `LARGE_API_SOURCE` (200), so it is not collapsed (`options.rs:98-100`).

**Intended or regression: intended.** It was already so in 0.11.0. `caliper-docgen-core@0.11.0` has the same `Full => true` at `react_types.rs:440`, and the earlier 0.11.0 demo showed 1,141 rows. The default is documented in `options.rs:17-19`: "`Full`: actually resolve `@types/react`'s real ... interface chain, matching RDT's full ~250-300 attributes per element — the default." No recent PR (469, 476, 485, 483, 480) changed it. PR 469's collapse correctly removed the 705 SystemProperties rows (1,141 to 437).

The expectation "the DOM source is one layer with 8 notable props under `dependencies`" is not what any doc promises. The nearest mode, `curated`, keeps every `aria-*`, every non-Capture handler and the globals (`react_types.rs:415-418`), so it gives 164 notables, not 8.

**Effect on a Storybook user.** About 290 DOM, ARIA and event rows bury the roughly 20 real props. Badge (two own props) shows 280 rows.

**Smallest fix**, from smallest:

1. Config only. Default `htmlAttributes` to `'curated'` in the addon (`packages/storybook/src/options.ts:40`, and its docs in `packages/storybook/src/index.ts:6-12`). Button goes to 314 rows (measured), Badge to 161. This is a small change but not the expected shape.
2. Contract fix (recommended). When collapse is not `none`, treat `@types/react`'s element attributes as the ambient layer they already are by `is_dom_file`. List only `notable_html_attrs(element)` (17 names for `button`) as `notableInherited`, and leave the rest to the element layer. Files:
   - `crates/core/src/types/options.rs`: drop the "@types/react never collapses" exemption at :89-90 and :102, or add a React clause.
   - `crates/core/src/react_types.rs`: `checker_prop_used` / `react_props_wanted` take the collapse mode.
   - `crates/core/src/pipeline/semantic_hook.rs`: `apply`, `target_of`.
   - The structural resolver's full-mode React expansion, so both lanes agree, plus a model test like `collapse_model.rs`.

   Button would show about 150 + 17 = **about 167 rows** (146 to 150 Chakra and own props, including the 130 conditions, plus the button notables). Badge would show 2 + span notables.

   Optionally, add Chakra's `Conditions` as a style source in `ambient.rs` (it is ambient, 130 > 30). Button would then drop to about 20 own + 17 notable = **about 37 rows**.

## B. @types/react recall about 0% with the checker on (CLI, collapse `none`)

**Cause.** The whole-project (CLI) merge drops every `react_declared` prop of a component that has any inheritance layer. In `crates/core/src/types/semantic.rs:429-437` (`apply_props`): `.filter(|prop| !prop.react_declared || (!layered && entry.props.contains_key(&prop.name)))`, followed by `Unanswered::Drop` (:439), which also removes the structural ones. The element layer is meant to "stand for them" (`crates/semantic/src/component.rs:33-37`). It ignores `htmlAttributes` and collapse, so `--collapse-inherited-props none` does not bring them back.
